answer: Perishable Sensor Quorum: an enrolling agent must obtain three live, timestamped signatures from distinct edge nodes—a thermal frame of a mesa, an acoustic pearl-drop, and a colorimetric saffron swatch under nonce lighting. Signatures hash sensor nonces and expire in 30s; each node serves one enrollment per epoch. Attackers must operate many physically separate, calibrated, low-latency sensor endpoints and pass cross-modal correlation—not just pay a fee.
